_comment: Cross-runtime vectors for the owner-anchored ROLE-TAGGED enroll SAS (enroll* in cross-domain-sas.ts). Read by src/__tests__/enroll-sas.test.ts (TS) AND, in the Android pass, SasCryptoTest.kt (Kotlin). `sas` = 6 decimal digits (SHA-256 of the ENROLL_SAS_V1 preimage -> first 8 bytes big-endian BigInt -> mod 10^6 -> zero-pad 6). The preimage is FIXED-SLOT/role-tagged (ADMIN block, ENROLLEE block, pin), so it is NOT order-independent: swapping roles OR reassigning fields changes the code. A `commitment` is base64 SHA-256 of the ENROLL_COMMIT_V1 preimage over one party + role + salt.

roleSwap._comment: Swapping ADMIN and ENROLLEE roles yields a DIFFERENT code (role-fixed, NOT order-independent). differsFrom = cases[0].sas.

fieldReassign._comment: Swapping ownerSignPub<->ownerBoxPub WITHIN the admin block changes the code (injective preimage; the red-team reassignment guard). differsFrom = cases[0].sas.

substitution._comment: An evie-substituted enrollee box key changes the code (the residual MITM detector after commit-reveal). differsFrom = cases[0].sas.

commitment._comment: ENROLL_COMMIT_V1 over the admin party + role ADMIN + salt.

commitmentRoleBinding._comment: The SAME party + salt under role ENROLLEE yields a DIFFERENT commitment (role is bound). differsFrom = commitment.commitment.

commitmentSaltBinding._comment: The SAME party + role under a DIFFERENT salt yields a DIFFERENT commitment (salt hides the keys). differsFrom = commitment.commitment.

handComputed._comment: Tiny non-key strings so the test can assert the EXACT canonical preimages. The SAS preimage is the fixed-slot ADMIN/ENROLLEE block layout; the commitment preimage is role-tagged fixed-order.
